// One click runs the whole bucks. Everything comes to YOUR Telegram, and nothing is booked or bought.

  DEMO: true,
  ME: 'You',

  VILLA: { name: 'Villa 7, Burleigh Heads', lat: -28.0919, lng: 153.4527 },
  GUEST_LIST_SIZE: 16,
  SHIRT: 'matching pink shirt',
  SLEEP_FLOOR: 50,                         // under this sleep score, the care package goes out

  MODEL: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
} }];

const S = $('Trev settings').first().json;
return [{ json: { caption: 'She said yes 💍 Can\'t wait to marry my best friend', image: S.POST_IMAGE, at: 'just now' } }];
